title: Restriction compatibility of external sections in the first factor
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P=X\times_kY$, $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to Y$, $H=p^*F\otimes q^*G$, and $N=\Gamma(Y,G)$ with its $k$-action [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison]. Define the presheaf $B(V)=\Gamma(p^{-1}V,H)$ of $k$-vector spaces on $X$. There is a presheaf morphism $c:(V\mapsto\Gamma(V,F)\otimes_kN)\to B$. At the top open its component followed by the canonical preimage-top section isomorphism is the canonical external tensor map. For each open $V\subseteq X$ there are $k$-linear source and target section isomorphisms $e_S:\Gamma(V,F)\otimes_kN\cong\Gamma(V,F|_V)\otimes_kN$ and $e_T:B(V)\cong\Gamma(V\times_kY, p_V^*(F|_V)\otimes q_V^*G)$ such that $e_T\circ c_V$ equals the canonical external tensor map over $V$ composed with $e_S$. No cover, bijectivity, quasi-coherence or compactness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the section unit as the adjoint of the scalar pullback coefficient. Tensor its first-factor component with the restriction of the second-factor global unit, and compose with the sectionwise tensor coefficient. Unit naturality and tmulSection_map prove naturality by tensor extensionality. At the top open, the two restrictions are tensorPullbackTopSection and yield the canonical externalGlobalSectionsTensor.

Apply the pure tensor open transport theorem for each V to get eS and eT. ModuleCat tensor extensionality extends its equality on s tensor t to equality of the two linear maps. This proves the local clause for the explicit natural transformation.

theorem exists_externalSectionsRestrictionComparisonLeft
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ c : scalarPresheaf f F ⋙
        MonoidalCategory.tensorRight (scalarObj g G (op ⊤)) ⟶
        externalSectionsPushforwardLeft f g F G,
      c.app (op ⊤) ≫ (externalSectionsTopIsoLeft f g F G).hom =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f g F G) ∧
      ∀ V : X.Opens,
        ∃ eS : (scalarPresheaf f F ⋙
            MonoidalCategory.tensorRight (scalarObj g G (op ⊤))).obj (op V) ≅
            ModuleCat.of k (scalarObj (V.ι ≫ f) (F.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤) ⊗[k]
              scalarObj g G (op ⊤)),
        ∃ eT : (externalSectionsPushforwardLeft f g F G).obj (op V) ≅
            scalarObj (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ f) g ≫ (V.ι ≫ f))
              (externalCupCoefficients (V.ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict V.ι) G) (op ⊤),
          c.app (op V) ≫ eT.hom = eS.hom ≫
            ModuleCat.ofHom
              (externalGlobalSectionsTensor (V.ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict V.ι) G)
